teaser: What does it cost to be the one everyone calls first? You are a 6, carrying the compound number 24 — the number a birth date adds up to before it reduces to one digit — and an ESTJ, built for order and for care at once. The 6 wants to hold a household or a team together through sheer attentiveness; the ESTJ wants to hold it together through clear rules and clear roles. In this crossing, love and management stop being separate jobs. The casserole gets made and the schedule gets enforced by the same hands, often in the same hour, and the asking of a favor comes out sounding like an assignment.
excerpt: The sign out front flickers on one side, half the letters dark, and still it says VACANCY plainly enough.
